editorial_reasons: The agency summary is closely reproduced in the opening.
The first-party observations are broad pre-event conditions, not sufficient bank-specific analysis; adding or repeating them to pass the quantitative floor would be padding.
The phrase material item for review infers significance from the penalty without admitted issuer-scale evidence.
The draft correctly distinguishes observation dates and denies unsupported share-price causality, but those improvements do not cure the failures.
